sentences.en: Today, the story of 20-year-old Army Specialist Vanessa Guillen, I spoke with my colleague Jennifer Steinhauer
sentences.zh: 今天，我们要讲述20岁陆军专家凡妮莎·吉伦的故事。我与同事詹妮弗·斯坦豪尔进行了交谈，

sentences.en: about what the case has revealed about the persistent culture of sexual harassment and fear inside the
sentences.zh: 探讨了这起案件揭示出的美国军队内部长期存在的性骚扰文化和恐惧氛围。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: military.
sentences.zh: 军队。

sentences.en: It's Friday, July 31St. Jennifer, what exactly happened to Vanessa Guillen?
sentences.zh: 今天是7月31日，星期五。詹妮弗，凡妮莎·吉伦到底发生了什么事？

sentences.en: So, Vanessa was reported missing by Fort Hood to law enforcement on April 23rd.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎于4月23日被胡德堡基地报告失踪，并通报给了执法部门。

sentences.en: Leaders in her unit had checked the barracks.
sentences.zh: 她所在部队的领导检查了营房。

sentences.en: They tried to contact her by her cell phone.
sentences.zh: 他们尝试通过手机联系她。

sentences.en: All of these efforts came up empty.
sentences.zh: 所有这些努力都一无所获。

sentences.en: And this massive search ensued.
sentences.zh: 随后展开了大规模的搜寻。

sentences.en: Tonight, U.S.
sentences.zh: 今晚，美国

sentences.en: Army officials are asking for the public's help in finding a missing soldier.
sentences.zh: 陆军官员请求公众协助寻找一名失踪士兵。

sentences.en: An extensive search is now underway by military members, as well as civilian and military police.
sentences.zh: 目前，军方人员以及民警和宪兵正在进行广泛的搜寻。

sentences.en: Volunteers scour the Central Texas Brush, searching for Private First Class Vanessa Guillen.
sentences.zh: 志愿者们在德克萨斯州中部灌木丛中搜寻一等兵凡妮莎·吉伦。

sentences.en: Everyone was just looking and looking and looking for where this missing soldier could be.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在不停地寻找，想知道这位失踪士兵可能在哪里。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: Army is now offering a $15,000 reward for information on the missing soldier.
sentences.zh: 陆军目前悬赏1.5万美元，征集有关这名失踪士兵的信息。

sentences.en: A Facebook page to help find her has also been made sharing pictures and information.
sentences.zh: 一个旨在帮助寻找她的 Facebook 页面也已建立，用于分享照片和信息。

sentences.en: In May, someone started a petition for the White House to hold the Army accountable for her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 5月，有人发起请愿，要求白宫让陆军对她的失踪负责。

sentences.en: Later in June, the family has a press conference.
sentences.zh: 后来在6月，她的家人召开了新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Vanessa had a sergeant come into a shower inappropriately, walk in.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎曾遇到一名士官不恰当地闯入淋浴间。

sentences.en: And they say that she'd been sexually harassed.
sentences.zh: 他们说她曾遭受性骚扰。

sentences.en: She did report that to her family and to her friends.
sentences.zh: 她确实向家人和朋友报告过此事。

sentences.en: But they can't get any information.
sentences.zh: 但他们无法获得任何信息。

sentences.en: They protest outside of Fort Hood.
sentences.zh: 他们在胡德堡基地外进行抗议。

sentences.en: Dozens of protesters have come out and are completely surrounding this block, making sure that everyone hears their message loud and clear.
sentences.zh: 数十名抗议者走上街头，完全包围了这个街区，确保每个人都能清楚地听到他们的诉求。

sentences.en: Where's my sister?
sentences.zh: 我妹妹在哪里？

sentences.en: They know where she is.
sentences.zh: 他们知道她在哪里。

sentences.en: And I want them to speak up.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们说出来。

sentences.en: And I want answers.
sentences.zh: 我想要答案。

sentences.en: And I want them now.
sentences.zh: 而且我现在就要。

sentences.en: So this is a multi-agency search for this missing woman.
sentences.zh: 这是一场由多个机构参与的失踪女子搜寻行动。

sentences.en: And she ultimately went missing for 70 days.
sentences.zh: 她最终失踪了70天。

sentences.en: Finally, a work crew found her remains near a lake in a rural area about 30 miles from her poSt. Hmm.
sentences.zh: 最终，一个工作组在她驻地约30英里外的一个农村地区的湖边发现了她的遗骸。嗯。

sentences.en: And who do they think is responsible for her death?
sentences.zh: 他们认为谁该为她的死负责？

sentences.en: Do they think it's connected to this alleged sexual harassment that she has described to her family?
sentences.zh: 他们认为这与她向家人描述的所谓性骚扰有关吗？

sentences.en: So, Army officials say that Vanessa never reported sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 陆军官员称，凡妮莎从未报告过性骚扰。

sentences.en: But her family believes that there was a connection between the harassment and her murder.
sentences.zh: 但她的家人认为骚扰与她的谋杀案之间存在联系。

sentences.en: Although, according to Army investigators, the criminal investigation hasn't found any credible connection with that yet.
sentences.zh: 尽管根据陆军调查人员的说法，刑事调查尚未发现任何可信的关联。

sentences.en: So what happened next?
sentences.zh: 那么接下来发生了什么？

sentences.en: So here's what investigators know.
sentences.zh: 调查人员掌握的情况如下。

sentences.en: They know that on April 22nd, Vanessa was in the barracks and she was called to do something at work in the arms room by Specialist Aaron David Robinson, who was her co-worker.
sentences.zh: 他们知道4月22日，凡妮莎在营房里，被她的同事、专家亚伦·大卫·罗宾逊叫去军械库处理工作。

sentences.en: So according to court documents, he'd given her the serial number for a machine gun that he wanted serviced.
sentences.zh: 根据法庭文件，他给了她一个他想要维修的机枪序列号。

sentences.en: So she went there and she left her car keys and so forth behind.
sentences.zh: 于是她去了那里，留下了车钥匙等等。

sentences.en: Her next stop should have been at the motor pool to drop off paperwork.
sentences.zh: 她的下一站本应是去车辆调度站递交文书。

sentences.en: She was expected to go there, but she never showed up.
sentences.zh: 她本应去那里，但却从未出现。

sentences.en: So what the authorities say is that they believe that somewhere in that encounter, Robinson killed her.
sentences.zh: 当局表示，他们认为在那个接触过程中，罗宾逊杀害了她。

sentences.en: And then he and his girlfriend dismembered and disposed of her body and her remains were found on June
sentences.zh: 随后，他和他的女友肢解并处理了她的尸体，她的遗骸于6月

sentences.en: 30th.
sentences.zh: 30日被发现。

sentences.en: That same day, as the police closed in on him, Robinson fatally shot himself.
sentences.zh: 同一天，当警方锁定他时，罗宾逊开枪自杀身亡。

sentences.en: And his girlfriend now faces trial on federal charges that she helped him dispose of Vanessa's body.
sentences.zh: 他的女友目前面临联邦指控，罪名是协助他处理凡妮莎的尸体。

sentences.en: So at this point, Jennifer, this murder suspect has killed himself.
sentences.zh: 那么詹妮弗，目前这名谋杀嫌疑人已经自杀。

sentences.en: His accomplice is in custody.
sentences.zh: 他的同伙已被拘留。

sentences.en: But correct me if I'm wrong, the criminal investigation has yet to find any connection between sexual harassment and Vanessa's murder.
sentences.zh: 但如果我没记错的话，请纠正我，刑事调查尚未发现性骚扰与凡妮莎谋杀案之间的任何联系，对吗？

sentences.en: That's right, Michael.
sentences.zh: 没错，迈克尔。

sentences.en: But at the same time, the revelations about Vanessa's death sparked a lot of outrage among women in the military.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，关于凡妮莎死因的披露在军中女性中引发了极大的愤怒。

sentences.en: Now hundreds of survivors of military sexual assault and harassment are speaking out using the hashtag I am Vanessa Guillen.
sentences.zh: 现在，数百名军队性侵犯和性骚扰的幸存者正使用“我是凡妮莎·吉伦”这一标签公开讲述自己的遭遇。

sentences.en: But what was more surprising to me was how much outrage it sparked outside the military.
sentences.zh: 但让我更惊讶的是，这在军队之外引发了多大的愤怒。

sentences.en: Well, dozens of people gathered today to march and demand justice for Vanessa Guillen.
sentences.zh: 今天有数十人聚集在一起游行，要求为凡妮莎·吉伦伸张正义。

sentences.en: Nobody I've spoken to here at the vigil knew Vanessa Guillen personally, but still so many people feel connected to her and her story.
sentences.zh: 我在守夜活动中交谈过的人中，没有谁私下认识凡妮莎·吉伦，但仍有许多人感到与她和她的故事息息相关。

sentences.en: I'm a mother.
sentences.zh: 我是一位母亲。

sentences.en: I can only imagine the pain that the mother's going through.
sentences.zh: 我只能想象那位母亲正在经历的痛苦。

sentences.en: Rosa Rodriguez Flores came to the vigil because she's...
sentences.zh: 罗莎·罗德里格斯·弗洛雷斯来到守夜现场是因为她……
zh_words: 罗莎·罗德里格斯·弗洛雷斯

sentences.en: There were all kinds of little makeshift memorials that were created all over the country.
sentences.zh: 全国各地都出现了各种各样的临时纪念活动。

sentences.en: Protest organized by NoMAS, a movement founded in her honor.
sentences.zh: 抗议活动由“NoMAS”组织，这是一个以她的名义成立的运动。

sentences.en: NoMAS means no more.
sentences.zh: “NoMAS”的意思是“不再”。

sentences.en: And they're now calling for no more sexual violence in the military.
sentences.zh: 他们现在呼吁军队中不再有性暴力。

sentences.en: Even celebrities like Rose McGowan, who obviously had been a prominent figure in the Me Too movement, was starting to talk on social media about Vanessa.
sentences.zh: 甚至像罗丝·麦高恩这样的名人，显然是“我也是”运动中的重要人物，也开始在社交媒体上谈论凡妮莎。

sentences.en: She showed up as the subject of Nancy Grace.
sentences.zh: 她成为了南希·格蕾丝节目的主题。

sentences.en: Even former Vice President Joe Biden put out a statement about it.
sentences.zh: 甚至前副总统乔·拜登也发表了相关声明。

sentences.en: So this was something that was quite unusual.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一件非常不寻常的事情。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: Well, these stories tend not to resonate that much outside of the military.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这些故事往往在军队之外不会引起太大的共鸣。

sentences.en: It seems to be almost this continual not-so-secret, dirty secret among women who are serving in female veterans.
sentences.zh: 这似乎成了服役女性和女性退伍军人之间一个持续存在、半公开的肮脏秘密。

sentences.en: Jennifer, why is that?
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗，为什么会这样？

sentences.en: So you have to remember that only 1% of our entire population serves the military.
sentences.zh: 你必须记住，我们整个人口中只有1%的人在军队服役。

sentences.en: So people serving our country, and particularly women, are very invisible in many ways.
sentences.zh: 所以为国效力的人，尤其是女性，在很多方面都是隐形的。

sentences.en: Now, that being said, there's been a history of these issues surfacing every few years.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，这些问题每隔几年就会浮出水面，这已成为一种历史。

sentences.en: And probably the most important incident...
sentences.zh: 而可能最重要的事件……

sentences.en: Next tonight, we focus on the tailhook scandal.
sentences.zh: 今晚接下来，我们关注“尾钩”丑闻。

sentences.en: ...was this very famous case called Tailhook.
sentences.zh: ……就是这个非常有名的“尾钩”案件。

sentences.en: The incidents of sexual assault and harassment have rocked the U.S.
sentences.zh: 性侵犯和性骚扰事件震撼了美国

sentences.en: Navy for more than a year ago.
sentences.zh: 海军，那是在一年多前。

sentences.en: So Tailhook was this annual aviator convention in Las Vegas, which basically went over the course of three days.
sentences.zh: “尾钩”是每年在拉斯维加斯举行的一场飞行员大会，基本上持续三天。

sentences.en: And hundreds and hundreds of people would convene and do all the things that you imagine at a convention in Las Vegas.
sentences.zh: 成百上千的人会聚集在一起，做你在拉斯维加斯会议上能想象到的所有事情。

sentences.en: Many attendees viewed the annual conference as a free fire zone, where they could act indiscriminately in matters of sexual conduct and drunkenness.
sentences.zh: 许多与会者将年度会议视为一个“自由开火区”，在那里他们可以在性行为和酗酒方面肆无忌惮。

sentences.en: But this particular convention was stunning in its level of debauchery.
sentences.zh: 但这次特别的会议在堕落程度上令人震惊。

sentences.en: And it was particularly notable because it was 1991, and the U.S.
sentences.zh: 而且特别值得注意的是，那是1991年，美国

sentences.en: had just prevailed in the Persian Gulf War, and they were coming home to a celebration.
sentences.zh: 刚刚在波斯湾战争中获胜，他们正凯旋归来庆祝。

sentences.en: You had all these Navy and Marine aviators who were hanging around this, what was then the
sentences.zh: 当时所有的海军和海军陆战队飞行员都聚集在当时的

sentences.en: Las Vegas Hilton, drinking.
sentences.zh: 拉斯维加斯希尔顿酒店喝酒。

sentences.en: They were getting sick all over the place.
sentences.zh: 他们到处都在呕吐。

sentences.en: There were a number of reported instances of public or paid sex.
sentences.zh: 有许多关于公开性行为或买春的报道。

sentences.en: And as women would come into the area, they would be harassed, they would be grabbed.
sentences.zh: 当女性进入该区域时，她们会受到骚扰，会被人抓摸。

sentences.en: They called it the Gauntlet, a hallway at the Las Vegas Hilton, where dozens of women were assaulted by a mob of military men attending Tailhook.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为“挑战长廊”，这是拉斯维加斯希尔顿酒店的一条走廊，数十名女性在那里被参加“尾钩”大会的一群军人袭击。

sentences.en: They were bitten, having their clothing ripped as they walked through there.
sentences.zh: 她们被咬伤，衣服在走过那里时被撕破。

sentences.en: During the three days of the convention, 83 women were assaulted by men, and six men were assaulted by women.
sentences.zh: 在会议的三天里，有83名女性被男性袭击，6名男性被女性袭击。

sentences.en: I went down a hallway where every man in that hallway got a shot at me.
sentences.zh: 我走过一条走廊，走廊里的每个男人都对我动手动脚。

sentences.en: One of the victims was a naval officer, Paula Coughlin.
sentences.zh: 受害者之一是海军军官保拉·考夫林。

sentences.en: They were hands down my blouse.
sentences.zh: 他们的手伸进了我的衬衫里。

sentences.en: At one point when I dropped to the floor, and I was biting the man who had his hands in my blouse.
sentences.zh: 有一次我跌倒在地，我咬了那个把手伸进我衬衫里的男人。

sentences.en: And the next morning, Ms. Coughlin did what anyone would have done.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，考夫林女士做了任何一个人都会做的事。

sentences.en: She talked to her superior, who at the time was Rear Admiral Jack Snyder.
sentences.zh: 她向她的上级报告了，当时是海军少将杰克·斯奈德。

sentences.en: And according to her, he said to her, well, that's what you get for going down a hallway with a bunch of drunken aviators.
sentences.zh: 据她说，他对她说，好吧，这就是你和一群喝醉的飞行员走过走廊的下场。

sentences.en: Now, I should say that Admiral Snyder said in his deposition that he didn't know about the assault until two weeks later.
sentences.zh: 现在，我应该说明，斯奈德少将在证词中表示，他在两周后才知道这次袭击。

sentences.en: And so, because she was being stonewalled, she decided to take it to the media.
sentences.zh: 因此，由于她受到阻挠，她决定向媒体曝光。

sentences.en: So far, the scandal has brought the resignations of a former Navy secretary and a number of admirals.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，这起丑闻已导致一名前海军部长和多名海军上将辞职。

sentences.en: And this was sort of a bomb that went off.
sentences.zh: 这就像一颗炸弹爆炸了。

sentences.en: This has been a difficult issue for the Navy because it told us that we had an institutional problem in how we treated women.
sentences.zh: 这对海军来说是一个棘手的问题，因为它告诉我们，我们在对待女性的方式上存在制度性问题。

sentences.en: The Navy was very criticized for not really looking into this properly in the beginning.
sentences.zh: 海军因起初没有对此进行适当调查而受到严厉批评。

sentences.en: In that regard, it was a watershed event that has brought about cultural change.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，这是一个带来文化变革的分水岭事件。

sentences.en: This then instigated investigations by the Senate Armed Services Committee.
sentences.zh: 这随后引发了参议院军事委员会的调查。

sentences.en: The process of disciplinary procedures and possible courts-martial now goes forward for an additional 117 Navy and Marine officers.
sentences.zh: 纪律处分程序和可能的军事法庭审判程序现在正针对另外117名海军和海军陆战队军官展开。

sentences.en: But in the end, you know, she was so incredibly harassed.
sentences.zh: 但最终，你知道，她受到了极其严重的骚扰。

sentences.en: She said she was called a lying slut many times.
sentences.zh: 她说她多次被骂作“撒谎的荡妇”。

sentences.en: She had drinks thrown at her in restaurants.
sentences.zh: 她在餐馆里被人泼饮料。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: Members of her family lost friends, lost business.
sentences.zh: 她的家人失去了朋友，生意也受到了影响。

sentences.en: So, ultimately, Paula resigned from the Navy in 1994.
sentences.zh: 最终，保拉于1994年从海军辞职。

sentences.en: And this was a case that was at once extremely well-known and yet, in the end, did not have
sentences.zh: 这是一个既极其出名，但最终却没有产生

sentences.en: such a great cultural impact in terms of a movement to protect women in the military against these types of harassments and worse in what is essentially a work environment.
sentences.zh: 太大文化影响的案件，没能形成一场保护军队女性免受此类骚扰及更严重伤害的运动，而这本质上是一个工作环境。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.zh: 解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间跨越付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获得30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Jennifer, as someone who has reported for quite some time on military culture, what did you
sentences.zh: 詹妮弗，作为一名长期报道军事文化的记者，你最终

sentences.en: ultimately make of the experience of Paula Coughlin, this woman who tried to report really grotesque sexual harassment and was ultimately hounded out?
sentences.zh: 如何看待保拉·考夫林的经历？她试图举报极其恶劣的性骚扰，最终却被逼离职。

sentences.en: So yeah, in some sense, as you say, that convention was so extreme and so gross that it felt absolutely unique.
sentences.zh: 是的，在某种意义上，正如你所说，那次会议太极端、太恶心了，感觉绝对是独一无二的。

sentences.en: But what happened to her actually wasn't really at all.
sentences.zh: 但发生在她身上的事，实际上一点也不罕见。

sentences.en: And that is both a combination of cultural issues within the military, as well as technical
sentences.zh: 这既是军队内部文化问题的结合，也是技术性

sentences.en: issues, legal issues, if you will, about how crimes against women of this sort, and men, I should add, are adjudicated in the military system.
sentences.zh: 问题，或者说是法律问题，关于这类针对女性——我应该补充说，还有男性——的犯罪在军事系统中是如何裁决的。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could start with the cultural problem.
sentences.zh: 我想请你先从文化层面的问题谈起。

sentences.en: So women in any workplace can relate to the idea that they have to prove themselves more than men do.
sentences.zh: 任何职场的女性都能感同身受，那就是她们必须比男性付出更多努力来证明自己。

sentences.en: And that is certainly true in the military, where women only recently have been entering certain combat roles.
sentences.zh: 在军队中更是如此，尽管女性直到最近才开始进入某些战斗岗位。

sentences.en: And once you enter the military, that's a close-knit organization.
sentences.zh: 一旦进入军队，那是一个联系紧密的组织。

sentences.en: It's not like another workplace.
sentences.zh: 它不像其他职场。

sentences.en: You're living together, right?
sentences.zh: 你们住在一起，对吧？

sentences.en: Camaraderie is not only essential to the culture, it's essential to the mission.
sentences.zh: 同志情谊不仅是军队文化的核心，更是完成任务的关键。

sentences.en: And part of the way, unfortunately, that women are often pressured to fit into the military is to be, quote, one of the guys.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，女性为了融入军队，往往被迫要成为所谓的“哥们儿”之一。

sentences.en: They're expected to be, you know, essentially tougher and to take things.
sentences.zh: 人们期望她们，你知道，本质上要更强硬，要能忍受一切。

sentences.en: And so that makes it more difficult sometimes to discern harassment, and then certainly to report on it.
sentences.zh: 这使得有时很难辨别骚扰行为，更不用说去举报了。

sentences.en: And once you do report on it, you are often considered by your peers and your superiors
sentences.zh: 一旦你举报了，你的同僚和上级往往会认为

sentences.en: to be the problem, that you're the one who's messing with this cohesion and this camaraderie.
sentences.zh: 你才是那个有问题的人，认为是你破坏了这种凝聚力和同志情谊。

sentences.en: And of course, not all men in the military view their colleagues, their female colleagues that way.
sentences.zh: 当然，并非军队中所有的男性都以这种眼光看待他们的女性同事。

sentences.en: So I don't mean to portray women in the military as under constant assault.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说要将军队中的女性描绘成时刻处于被侵犯的状态。

sentences.en: That's not the way it is.
sentences.zh: 事实并非如此。

sentences.en: But once they are harassed or worse, they often do find that this sense of what are you doing there to begin with can set in.
sentences.zh: 但一旦她们遭受骚扰甚至更严重的对待，她们往往会发现，那种“你当初为什么要来这里”的质疑感就会随之而来。

sentences.en: So culturally, the deck is kind of stacked against women.
sentences.zh: 所以在文化上，女性确实处于劣势。

sentences.en: What about the legal, the kind of technical obstacles involved in bringing harassment claims to light?
sentences.zh: 那么在法律层面，也就是在提出骚扰指控时涉及的技术性障碍又如何呢？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: People may be surprised to learn, who don't know much about the military, that the military justice system is quite different from the civilian justice system.
sentences.zh: 对于不太了解军队的人来说，可能会惊讶地发现，军事司法系统与民事司法系统截然不同。

sentences.en: And when we're talking about these harassment cases and worse, right, it's military commanders who decide to begin with who's prosecuted and for what.
sentences.zh: 当我们谈论这些骚扰案件甚至更严重的案件时，决定起诉谁以及以什么罪名起诉的，是军事指挥官。

sentences.en: And then they pick the jurors.
sentences.zh: 然后由他们挑选陪审员。

sentences.en: And then they review the verdicts.
sentences.zh: 接着由他们审查判决结果。

sentences.en: And then when people are convicted and sentenced, the commander can also decide to throw those sentences out.
sentences.zh: 当有人被定罪和判刑后，指挥官还可以决定撤销这些判决。

sentences.en: And that's happened repeatedly.
sentences.zh: 这种情况屡见不鲜。

sentences.en: But there's a reason that the military justice system works that way.
sentences.zh: 但军事司法系统这样运作是有原因的。

sentences.en: It's so all disciplinary actions are kept within the chain of command.
sentences.zh: 这是为了确保所有的纪律处分都保持在指挥链之内。

sentences.en: And that's so important to keeping the cohesion in the military.
sentences.zh: 这对维持军队的凝聚力至关重要。

sentences.en: But the problem with that system is, in cases of sexual assault in particular, the system tends not to favor the victim.
sentences.zh: 但该系统的问题在于，特别是在性侵犯案件中，系统往往不利于受害者。

sentences.en: It tends to favor the accused.
sentences.zh: 它往往偏袒被告。

sentences.en: And so this system is a major impediment for men and women seeking justice in these kinds of cases.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于寻求此类案件正义的男女军人来说，这个系统是一个巨大的障碍。

sentences.en: So Jennifer, given those cultural and logistical obstacles, how frequently are there successful
sentences.zh: 那么珍妮弗，考虑到这些文化和后勤方面的障碍，在出现性骚扰指控时，

sentences.en: prosecutions or punishments when there are allegations of sexual harassment in the military?
sentences.zh: 成功起诉或惩处的频率有多高？

sentences.en: So the Pentagon regularly surveys men and women in the military.
sentences.zh: 五角大楼会定期对军队中的男女军人进行调查。

sentences.en: And there are tens of thousands of respondents, literally, who say that they've been assaulted in the military.
sentences.zh: 确实有成千上万的受访者表示他们在军队中遭受过侵犯。

sentences.en: But a fraction of those have actually been officially reported.
sentences.zh: 但其中只有一小部分被正式报告了。

sentences.en: And when they are reported, an even smaller fraction of those actually go to trial.
sentences.zh: 而在报告的案件中，只有更小的一部分真正进入了审判程序。

sentences.en: For those that go to trial, a larger percentage actually result in convictions.
sentences.zh: 对于那些进入审判程序的案件，有较大比例最终定罪。

sentences.en: But now you're looking at a very small pool from our original number.
sentences.zh: 但现在你面对的是最初总数中极小的一部分。

sentences.en: And in many cases, sometimes when you have those convictions, they're overturned.
sentences.zh: 而且在许多情况下，即使有了定罪，判决有时也会被推翻。

sentences.en: So Jennifer, knowing that math, just how rare these cases are brought, just how rarely they
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗，了解了这些数据，知道这些案件被提起诉讼的频率如此之低，

sentences.en: are successfully prosecuted, I have to imagine that there have been tremendous pressure to fix this system, right?
sentences.zh: 成功起诉的频率也如此之低，我想一定有巨大的压力要求改革这个系统，对吧？

sentences.en: And to make the military more responsive and accountable to allegations of harassment.
sentences.zh: 并使军队对骚扰指控做出更积极的回应和问责。

sentences.en: So there have been incremental changes to how women are treated in the military.
sentences.zh: 军队中女性受到的待遇确实发生了一些渐进式的改变。

sentences.en: But the issue of how sexual assault cases are prosecuted, both for women and for men, has been this subject of debate for decades.
sentences.zh: 但关于如何起诉性侵案件的问题，无论是针对女性还是男性，几十年来一直都是争论的焦点。

sentences.en: And this sort of all came to a head in 2013, when Senator Kirsten Gillibrand of New York, who
sentences.zh: 这一切在2013年达到了顶峰，当时来自纽约州的参议员克里斯汀·吉利布兰德，

sentences.en: was on the Senate Armed Services Committee, decided to take this issue on in a big way.
sentences.zh: 她是参议院军事委员会的成员，决定大力解决这个问题。

sentences.en: We all know that our military is home to the best and the brightest in the world.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，我们的军队汇集了世界上最优秀、最聪明的人才。

sentences.en: And there is such a small number of criminals within our military that are undermining good order and discipline and destroying lives.
sentences.zh: 军队中只有极少数罪犯在破坏良好的秩序和纪律，并摧毁他人的生活。

sentences.en: What Gillibrand really wanted to do was try to change how these crimes are dealt with.
sentences.zh: 吉利布兰德真正想做的是改变处理这些犯罪的方式。

sentences.en: What several of us are asserting and arguing today is we think you should do what other countries around the world who we fight with every day.
sentences.zh: 我们今天有几个人在主张和论证，我们认为你们应该效仿我们每天并肩作战的其他国家。

sentences.en: They've taken the serious crimes out of the chain of command for precisely this reason.
sentences.zh: 正是出于这个原因，他们已经将严重犯罪的处理权从指挥链中剥离了出来。

sentences.en: So she wanted to give military prosecutors the authority to decide which sexual assault cases even go to trial instead of commanders.
sentences.zh: 所以她想赋予军事检察官权力，由他们而不是指挥官来决定哪些性侵案件可以进入审判程序。

sentences.en: Not all commanders are objective.
sentences.zh: 并非所有指挥官都是客观的。

sentences.en: Not every single commander necessarily wants women in the force.
sentences.zh: 并非每一位指挥官都一定欢迎女性进入部队。

sentences.en: Not every single commander believes what a sexual assault is.
sentences.zh: 并非每一位指挥官都理解什么是性侵犯。

sentences.en: And the reason for that is that would protect victims by having a legal professional evaluate their case.
sentences.zh: 这样做的理由是，通过让法律专业人士评估案件，可以保护受害者。

sentences.en: This set of prosecutors are trained for sexual assault and rape within the military.
sentences.zh: 这批检察官受过专门针对军队内部性侵犯和强奸案件的培训。

sentences.en: They know the law and they know whether they can win these cases.
sentences.zh: 他们了解法律，也知道能否赢得这些案件。

sentences.en: So I want that trained military prosecutor, not any commander.
sentences.zh: 所以我想要的是受过训练的军事检察官，而不是任何指挥官。

sentences.en: She also wanted to move the authority to convene the court martial trials outside of the chain
sentences.zh: 她还希望将召集军事法庭审判的权力移出指挥链，

sentences.en: and command as well, because by removing that authority from the commander, the idea was that survivors would also be better protected.
sentences.zh: 因为通过将这一权力从指挥官手中剥离，其初衷是让幸存者也能得到更好的保护。

sentences.en: So that is what we are here to do.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们来到这里的目的。

sentences.en: We have to answer the call of these victiMs.
sentences.zh: 我们必须回应这些受害者的呼声。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So in some ways, it's kind of a simple solution to a lot of these probleMs.
sentences.zh: 所以从某种程度上说，这对于解决许多此类问题是一个简单的方案。

sentences.en: Take the decision making about who is prosecuted out of the hands of military leaders.
sentences.zh: 将关于谁被起诉的决策权从军队领导手中拿走。

sentences.en: In some ways, you say this sounds simple, but it's really not simple at all because of the differences of both the culture and the way that the military functions.
sentences.zh: 在某些方面，你说这听起来很简单，但由于文化差异以及军队运作方式的不同，这其实一点也不简单。

sentences.en: In fact, to overturn that is basically putting a stick in the eye of the entire culture of what the command structure is in the military.
sentences.zh: 事实上，推翻这一点基本上等同于挑战军队整个指挥结构的文化。

sentences.en: So what is the reaction to it?
sentences.zh: 那么对此有什么反应呢？

sentences.en: So the response was pretty interesting and largely negative.
sentences.zh: 反应相当有趣，而且在很大程度上是负面的。

sentences.en: Obviously, a lot of leaders in the military didn't like it at all.
sentences.zh: 显然，军队中的许多领导人一点也不喜欢这样。

sentences.en: But most interestingly...
sentences.zh: 但最有趣的是……

sentences.en: First, let me say with all my heart how much I respect Senator Gillibrand's leadership on this issue.
sentences.zh: 首先，我要衷心地说，我非常尊重吉利布兰德参议员在这一问题上的领导力。

sentences.en: ...was then-Senator Claire McCaskill, another Democrat from Missouri.
sentences.zh: ……当时是参议员克莱尔·麦卡斯基尔，另一位来自密苏里州的民主党人。

sentences.en: We have an honest disagreement on how best to accomplish our shared goal of putting predators in prison and supporting victims during the most difficult moments of their lives.
sentences.zh: 我们在如何最好地实现共同目标上存在诚实的分歧，即如何将掠夺者送进监狱，并在受害者一生中最困难的时刻支持他们。

sentences.en: She wanted to have a much more sort of pared back version.
sentences.zh: 她想要一个更温和、更精简的版本。

sentences.en: We all know that there's a desire to solve this problem.
sentences.zh: 我们都知道，人们渴望解决这个问题。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of women on the committee who also opposed Gillibrand's measure.
sentences.zh: 委员会中也有许多女性反对吉利布兰德的提议。

sentences.en: But we cannot let it blind our judgment.
sentences.zh: 但我们不能让它蒙蔽了我们的判断。

sentences.en: But then there were others who were somewhat surprising who supported her.
sentences.zh: 但随后也有一些令人惊讶的人支持她。

sentences.en: I was persuaded by Senator Gillibrand's exceptionally passionate and able advocacy.
sentences.zh: 我被吉利布兰德参议员极其热情和有力的辩护所说服。

sentences.en: Ted Cruz of Texas.
sentences.zh: 来自德克萨斯州的泰德·克鲁兹。

sentences.en: Senator Gillibrand, I believe, made a persuasive case that keeping the reporting in the chain of command, as Rand said, has proven, in fact, to be deterring victims from reporting
sentences.zh: 我相信吉利布兰德参议员提出了一个有说服力的论点，正如兰德所说，事实证明，将报告权保留在指挥链内，实际上是在阻碍受害者举报

sentences.en: their crimes.
sentences.zh: 他们的罪行。

sentences.en: And at the time, Senator David Vitter of Louisiana, who were probably two of the most conservative
sentences.zh: 当时，来自路易斯安那州的参议员大卫·维特，他们可能是当时委员会中最保守的两位

sentences.en: Republicans on the committee at that time, sided with Gillibrand.
sentences.zh: 共和党人，站在了吉利布兰德一边。

sentences.en: But in the end, on this vote, the ayes are 55, the nays are 45.
sentences.zh: 但最终，在这次投票中，赞成票为55票，反对票为45票。

sentences.en: After a lengthy, heated debate on the floor, when it came time to vote, Gillibrand's measure came five votes short.
sentences.zh: 经过参议院冗长而激烈的辩论，当投票时刻到来时，吉利布兰德的提案以五票之差未获通过。

sentences.en: The motion is not agreed to.
sentences.zh: 该动议未获通过。

sentences.en: And the bill is returned to the calendar.
sentences.zh: 法案被退回日程表。

sentences.en: And so Gillibrand was defeated.
sentences.zh: 所以吉利布兰德失败了。

sentences.en: And every year since then, Senator Gillibrand has attempted to bring a version of that as an amendment to the defense bill.
sentences.zh: 从那以后的每一年，吉利布兰德参议员都试图将该法案的一个版本作为国防法案的修正案提出。

sentences.en: And so far, she has not succeeded.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，她还没有成功。

sentences.en: Which I think brings us to today and to Vanessa Guillen.
sentences.zh: 我认为这把我们带到了今天，带到了凡妮莎·吉伦的案件。

sentences.en: And you had said, Jennifer, that that case quickly galvanized civilians and soldiers who are fed up with the current system not changing.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗，你曾说过，那个案件迅速激怒了对现状不改感到厌倦的平民和士兵。

sentences.en: What about lawmakers in Washington?
sentences.zh: 华盛顿的立法者们呢？

sentences.en: How have they responded to her death?
sentences.zh: 他们对她的死有何反应？

sentences.en: So if you think about this almost as a beach ball that's always up in the air, right?
sentences.zh: 如果你把这想象成一个总是在空中飞舞的沙滩球，对吧？

sentences.en: Everyone keeps hitting the ball, hitting the ball.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在不断地击打这个球。

sentences.en: It's moving from advocacy groups.
sentences.zh: 它在倡导团体之间传递。

sentences.en: It's moving all around.
sentences.zh: 它在四处移动。

sentences.en: Vanessa's death really knocked that beach ball back into the halls of Congress.
sentences.zh: 凡妮莎的死确实把那个沙滩球又打回了国会大厅。

sentences.en: And one thing that's happened since Senator Gillibrand first introduced that legislation is the 2018 midterm elections, which ushered in a whole new group of women in Congress.
sentences.zh: 自吉利布兰德参议员首次提出该立法以来，发生的一件事是2018年的中期选举，这让一批全新的女性进入了国会。

sentences.en: Among those women, you have a fair number of female veterans and those who were in other service jobs like the CIA and so forth.
sentences.zh: 在这些女性中，有相当一部分是女性退伍军人，以及曾在中央情报局等其他服务部门工作过的人。

sentences.en: So I think you're really seeing not just the presence of women on armed services committees in the House and Senate, but you're seeing the specific importance of having more female
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，你不仅看到了女性在众议院和参议院军事委员会中的存在，而且你看到了拥有更多女性

sentences.en: veterans in Congress who are interested in this issue and perhaps bringing a different perspective to it.
sentences.zh: 退伍军人进入国会的重要性，她们对这个问题感兴趣，或许能带来不同的视角。

sentences.en: Jennifer, I wonder if you think that as powerful as this moment is, that change is possible inside the military.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗，我想知道你是否认为，尽管这一时刻很有影响力，但军队内部的变革是否可能实现。

sentences.en: You have explained why chain of command is such a powerful concept, how deep the reluctance is to disrupt it.
sentences.zh: 你已经解释了为什么指挥链是一个如此强大的概念，以及打破它的阻力有多深。

sentences.en: And the story that we have just told here is one where something pretty awful happens, whether it's Paul Coughlin or the hundreds, if not thousands of women who have complained and
sentences.zh: 我们刚才讲述的故事中，发生了一些非常可怕的事情，无论是保罗·考夫林，还是成百上千甚至上万名投诉并

sentences.en: been retaliated against, or more recently, the violent murder of Vanessa Guillen.
sentences.zh: 遭到报复的女性，或者最近发生的凡妮莎·吉伦被暴力谋杀的案件。

sentences.en: And even decades later, nothing seems to have meaningfully changed.
sentences.zh: 即使几十年过去了，似乎什么都没有发生实质性的改变。

sentences.en: Over the past 10 years, I have seen military leader after military leader come to Capitol
sentences.zh: 在过去的10年里，我看到一位又一位军事领导人来到国会

sentences.en: Hill and expert after expert testify before congressional committees saying the same thing over and over again, making the same promises over and over again.
sentences.zh: 山，一位又一位专家在国会委员会作证，一遍又一遍地说同样的话，一遍又一遍地做出同样的承诺。

sentences.en: And while there certainly have been incremental changes to policies inside the military, there
sentences.zh: 虽然军队内部的政策确实发生了一些渐进式的改变，但

sentences.en: hasn't really been a dent in the number of men and women complaining about sexual harassment and assault.
sentences.zh: 抱怨性骚扰和性侵犯的男女军人数量并没有真正减少。

sentences.en: I can't say where the change in how these cases are adjudicated by taking them out of the chain of the command is the answer.
sentences.zh: 我不能说通过将这些案件移出指挥链来改变审判方式是否就是答案。

sentences.en: But I can say that there has to be something completely different and radical and new within in the culture of the military to shift, to make some dent in this problem.
sentences.zh: 但我可以说，军队文化内部必须发生一些彻底的、激进的、全新的变化，才能在解决这个问题上取得一些进展。

sentences.en: Jennifer, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 珍妮弗，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you for paying attention to this issue, Michael.
sentences.zh: 感谢你关注这个问题，迈克尔。

sentences.en: And her daughter died.
sentences.zh: 而她的女儿去世了。

sentences.en: Her daughter died in service of the country from the hand of people who are in the military.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿在为国效力时，死于军队内部人员之手。

sentences.en: On Thursday, President Trump hosted the family of Vanessa Guillen, including her mother, sister
sentences.zh: 周四，特朗普总统在白宫会见了凡妮莎·吉伦的家人，包括她的母亲、姐妹

sentences.en: and the family's lawyer at the White House, where he promised them a, quote, very strong investigation into her death.
sentences.zh: 和家庭律师，并向他们承诺会对她的死进行一次“非常强有力的调查”。

sentences.en: As you know, the FBI and the DOJ are now involved.
sentences.zh: 如你所知，联邦调查局和司法部现在已经介入。

sentences.en: We got them involved.
sentences.zh: 我们让他们介入了。

sentences.en: And the people at Fort Hood, where it took place, are very much involved.
sentences.zh: 而事发地胡德堡的相关人员也深度参与其中。

sentences.en: We didn't want to have this swept under the rug, which could happen.
sentences.zh: 我们不想让这件事被掩盖，这种情况是有可能发生的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: The economic toll of the pandemic became clearer on Thursday when the government announced that
sentences.zh: 周四，当政府宣布该国国内生产总值（衡量经济健康状况的广泛指标）下降了近三分之一时，

sentences.en: the country's gross domestic product, a broad measure of economic health, fell by nearly a third.
sentences.zh: 疫情带来的经济损失变得更加清晰。

sentences.en: It was the most devastating three-month collapse on record.
sentences.zh: 这是有记录以来最惨重的三个月经济崩溃。

sentences.en: And it wiped out five years of economic growth.
sentences.zh: 它抹去了五年的经济增长。

sentences.en: And the coronavirus has claimed the life of a former presidential candidate, Herman Cain,
sentences.zh: 新冠病毒夺走了一位前总统候选人的生命，赫尔曼·凯恩，

sentences.en: a restaurant executive who sought the Republican nomination in 2012 and briefly led the field in polling.
sentences.zh: 一位餐厅高管，曾在2012年寻求共和党提名，并在民调中短暂领先。

sentences.en: Cain tested positive after attending an indoor rally for President Trump in Tulsa, Oklahoma in June, where he was photographed without a mask.
sentences.zh: 凯恩在六月份参加了特朗普总统在俄克拉荷马州塔尔萨举行的室内集会后检测呈阳性，当时他被拍到没有戴口罩。

sentences.en: He was hospitalized with COVID-19 soon after.
sentences.zh: 此后不久，他因感染新冠肺炎住院。

sentences.en: Finally.
sentences.zh: 最后。

sentences.en: From Troy to the sit-ins of Nashville, from the Freedom Rides to the March on Washington,
sentences.zh: 从特洛伊到纳什维尔的静坐示威，从自由乘车运动到华盛顿大游行，

sentences.en: from Freedom Summer to Selma, John Lewis always looked outward, not inward.
sentences.zh: 从自由之夏到塞尔玛，约翰·刘易斯总是向外看，而不是向内看。

sentences.en: He always thought of others.
sentences.zh: 他总是想着别人。

sentences.en: He always believed in preaching the gospel, in word and in deed, insisting that hate and fear had to be answered with love and hope.
sentences.zh: 他始终坚信要以言传身教的方式传播福音，坚持认为仇恨和恐惧必须用爱和希望来回应。

sentences.en: In Atlanta on Thursday, the funeral of Congressman John Lewis drew three living presidents, George
sentences.zh: 周四在亚特兰大，国会议员约翰·刘易斯的葬礼吸引了三位在世的总统，乔治·W·

sentences.en: W.
sentences.zh: 布什、比尔·克林顿和巴拉克·奥巴马，他们每人都为这位民权领袖发表了悼词。

sentences.en: Bush, Bill Clinton, and Barack Obama, each of whom delivered eulogies of the civil rights leader.
sentences.zh: 多么激进的想法。

sentences.en: What a radical idea.
sentences.zh: 多么革命性的观念。

sentences.en: What a revolutionary notion.
sentences.zh: 这个想法是，我们任何一个普通人，一个来自特洛伊的孩子，都可以站出来对抗权势和统治者，说：不，这是不对的，这不是事实。

sentences.en: This idea that any of us ordinary people, a young kid from Troy, can stand up to the powers and principalities and say, no, this isn't right, this isn't true.
sentences.zh: 这是不公正的。

sentences.en: This isn't juSt.
sentences.zh: 这是不公正的。

sentences.en: We can do better.
sentences.zh: 我们可以做得更好。

sentences.en: In his eulogy, President Obama said that America owes an enormous debt to John Lewis.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统在悼词中说，美国欠约翰·刘易斯一份巨大的债。

sentences.en: America was built by John Lewis.
sentences.zh: 美国是由约翰·刘易斯所建立的。

sentences.en: He, as much as anyone in our history, brought this country a little bit closer to our highest ideas.
sentences.zh: 他与我们历史上任何人一样，让这个国家离我们最崇高的理想更近了一步。

sentences.en: And someday when we do finish that long journey towards freedom, when we do form a more perfect
sentences.zh: 总有一天，当我们走完那段通往自由的漫长旅程，当我们真正建立起一个更完美的

sentences.en: future, whether it's years from now or decades or even if it takes another two centuries, John
sentences.zh: 未来时，无论是在几年后、几十年后，甚至还需要再过两个世纪，约翰·刘易斯

sentences.en: Lewis will be a founding father of that fuller, fairer, better America.
sentences.zh: 都将是那个更充实、更公平、更美好的美国的开国元勋。

sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.zh: 周一见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter Show》节目，我们将为您准备假期接待客人的相关事宜。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 敬请收听，获取让客人们宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝断片了才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
